_comment: SAPM chain safety configuration: gas budgets, slippage limits, and transaction risk controls.
_policy: All transaction-submitting agents must load and enforce these limits. Exceeding any limit must abort the transaction before submission.

createMarket.description: Maximum gas for a createMarket PTB (500M MIST = 0.5 SUI)

placeTrade.description: Maximum gas for a placeTrade PTB (200M MIST = 0.2 SUI)

resolveMarket.description: Maximum gas for a resolveMarket PTB (300M MIST = 0.3 SUI)

default.description: Default maximum gas for any other PTB (100M MIST = 0.1 SUI)

slippageLimits.description: Maximum acceptable price slippage in basis points (200 bps = 2%)
slippageLimits.description2: Hard abort threshold: any trade with >5% slippage must be rejected

retryPolicy.description: Bounded idempotent retry policy for failed transactions

preflight.description: All transactions must pass dryRun preflight before mainnet submission
